sloka: प्रयाता राक्षसास्तूर्णं देवलोकं प्रयत्नतः ।रक्षसामेव मार्गेण दैवतान्यपचक्रमुः ।। ७.६.५२ ॥
transliteration: prayātā rākṣasāstūrṇaṁ devalokaṁ prayatnataḥ ।rakṣasāmeva mārgeṇa daivatānyapacakramuḥ ।। 7.6.52 ॥

translations.english: The Rakshasas quickly departed to the world of gods with great effort, and even the deities departed by the very path used by the Rakshasas.
